title: Predict the sign of IDF for a common term
concept: IDF is a log-odds ratio. Above half the collection, the odds are below 1 and the log is negative.
skill: You can look at a document frequency and say, before computing anything, whether that term argues for or against relevance.
deeper: docs/30-learning/interview-prep/01-mathematical-foundations/bm25-from-first-principles.md -- the derivation that makes the sign inevitable
